description: Is this crypto address on OFAC’s SDN sanctions list? SDN entry, program, asset and list date for Bitcoin, Ethereum and EVM, Tron, Solana and other addresses, checked by Distill against OFAC’s own SDN file. Matches one digital currency address (Bitcoin, Ethereum and every EVM chain, Tron, Solana, Monero, …) against the “Digital Currency Address” identifiers of OFAC’s Specially Designated Nationals list, read from OFAC’s Sanctions List Service SDN.XML and refreshed daily. Returns whether it is listed in the latest publication, each listing’s SDN entry (UID, name, type, programs), asset and chain, the publication date, and any earlier listing a later publication removed. Not listed is an answer too. Exact match only; not a compliance determination. The address is not stored. Updated daily. Price: $0.005 per call. Free tier: 3 free calls a day per IP, at most 3 rows per answer, taken by an unpaid call unless its _meta["distill/free-tier"] is "skip". Confidence: Freshness only (the list is OFAC’s, matched exactly): 1 until 3 days after the last check of OFAC’s Sanctions List Service, then halving every 3 days. Facts from the OFAC SDN list as published on the date stated: an exact match of the address as given (EVM and Bech32 addresses case-insensitively). Not legal advice and not a compliance determination: no ownership (50% rule) analysis, no indirect exposure, no other sanctions list. Computed by Distill from OFAC’s SDN.XML. See /terms.
